flags.message: The CVSG order is dated 2026-10-05, the snapshot day itself, so this distribution-moment cell was forecast from a CVSG-issued state with one distribution. The cvsg-increment claim is stated as 0.0 and is vacuous by construction; the disposition forecast anchors on the sal-v4 high band's pooled reached rate (OT2017-OT2025), which already conditions on the CVSG. No data-quality problem; recorded so the evaluator reads the conditioning correctly if a separate evt-order-cvsg-disposition cell is later minted for this docket.
